{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: routes cliproxy-claude and cliproxy-openai through a local CLIProxyAPI, so the agent reaches your own CLI subscriptions","id":"gh:1342866972","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-cliproxy","slug":"DevViking-Persike/dsh-cliproxy","topics":["cliproxyapi","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: routes cliproxy-claude and cliproxy-openai through a local CLIProxyAPI, so "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"the agent reaches your own CLI subscriptions"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-cliproxy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Routes Claude, OpenAI/Codex, and **Gemini through Antigravity OAuth** in DeepSeek Harness through on"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"e local CLIProxyAPI instance."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The Gemini route uses your Google/Antigravity account — **not a Gemini API key**. CLIProxyAPI owns t"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"he browser login, refresh token, Google project, native request fingerprint, and translation; this p"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"lugin is its OpenAI-compatible DSH client."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| DSH provider | Authentication owned by CLIProxyAPI |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| `cliproxy-claude` | Claude Code subscription |
| `cliproxy-openai` | Codex/OpenAI subscription |
|"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" `cliproxy-gemini` | Google Antigravity OAuth |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Restart DSH. The enabled routes query `/v1/models` when the Harness requests their catalogs, so only"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" models currently exposed by your proxy appear. Installing the plugin does not perform OAuth login."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"When Claude and Codex already come from `dsh-subscriptions`, enable only `routes: [gemini]` here to "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"avoid presenting alternative proxy routes for the same model families."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Gemini / AGY (Antigravity) Login"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"CLIProxyAPI owns Antigravity OAuth login. Run this once:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Authorize the Google account in the browser. CLIProxyAPI writes `antigravity-<email>.json` under its"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" configured `auth-dir` (normally `~/.cli-proxy-api`) and refreshes it itself. This DSH plugin never "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"reads the Google access or refresh tokens."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The key named below is only the local proxy's access control between DSH and `127.0.0.1:8317`; it is"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" **not** a Gemini API key. For a loopback endpoint, the plugin reads the first `api-keys` entry from"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" the local CLIProxyAPI config by default, so no environment variable is required and the key is neve"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"LIProxyAPI config by default, so no environment variable is required and the key is never displayed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- A running CLIProxyAPI instance; default endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1`.
- For Gemini, a compl"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"eted `-antigravity-login`.
- Either a proxy access key in the harness credential store / `CLIPROXY_A"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"PI_KEY`, or a readable local proxy config. Local config discovery is allowed only for loopback URLs;"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" a local key is never sent to a remote endpoint implicitly."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Every field is optional."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `routes` | `[claude, openai, gemini]` | Provider families to register. Use `[gemini]` alongside `d"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"sh-subscriptions`. |
| `discoverModels` | `true` | Query the authenticated `/v1/models` endpoint for"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" available model ids. Set `false` for an explicitly managed offline catalog. |
| `modelDiscoveryTime"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"outMs` | `10000` | Deadline for each catalog request. |
| `baseURL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1` | E"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ndpoint including `/v1`. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `CLIPROXY_API_KEY` | Optional credential reference/enviro"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"nment variable for the proxy access key. |
| `proxyConfigPath` | `/opt/homebrew/etc/cliproxyapi.conf"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"` | Local CLIProxyAPI YAML from which the first proxy access key may be read. |
| `readLocalProxyKey"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"` | `true` | Allow local config discovery for loopback endpoints only. |
| `claudeModels` | six Clau"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"de entries | Catalog for `cliproxy-claude`; a supplied array replaces the default. |
| `openaiModels"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"` | five GPT entries | Catalog for `cliproxy-openai`. |
| `geminiModels` | eight Gemini entries | An"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"tigravity catalog for `cliproxy-gemini`. |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Budget between strea"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"m reads. |
| `defaultContextWindow` | `200000` | Context assumed for an uncatalogued model. |
| `max"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"Tokens` | `32000` | Default output cap. |
| `retryPolicy` | normal, 3 retries | Merged over the harn"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"ess-compatible default. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Discovery and Routing"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The proxy's OpenAI model endpoint exposes available ids, not context windows or image capabilities. "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"This plugin attaches configured metadata for known ids. New ids with the route's `claude-`, `gpt-`, "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"or `gemini-` prefix appear as text-only with the configured default context and output limits. Custo"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"m aliases must be listed in the corresponding model catalog. An explicit catalog restricts discovery"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" to its listed ids; it does not advertise configured models absent from the proxy response. Catalog "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"errors remain visible and do not silently fall back to potentially unavailable models."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The Gemini route identifies a model family, not an authenticated Google account. CLIProxyAPI chooses"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" the backend and account; configure it to serve Gemini through Antigravity if that is the intended c"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"redential source. Account eligibility and quotas remain controlled by Google. No Google OAuth client"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" secret, access token, or refresh token is bundled with this plugin. Existing Claude/Codex authentic"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ation remains in `dsh-subscriptions` when that plugin is used."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Pin Gemini to Antigravity"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`routes: [gemini]` selects the Harness model family; it does not select a backend account. If the pr"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"oxy also serves Gemini through other providers, create a unique alias under its Antigravity OAuth ch"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"annel, as supported by the CLIProxyAPI configuration:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Then select only that alias in the Harness plugin configuration:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Keep the alias exclusive to Antigravity across all proxy providers. Model ids and limits must match "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"the upstream model actually exposed by your installation. Discovery will list the alias only after C"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"LIProxyAPI exposes it. This configuration is an operator example; installing this plugin does not re"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"write your proxy configuration or initiate login."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Safety"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- Google access/refresh tokens remain entirely inside CLIProxyAPI's `auth-dir`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Discovery reflects the proxy catalog at the time it is requested; availability can change before d"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ispatch. An uncatalogued model still resolves when named explicitly, with default limits and text-on"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ly input.
- No audio/video serialization. Image support requires both configured model capability an"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"d the Harness attachment service.
- The plugin has no settings-directory entry; it is configured by "},{"id":"p37s5","text":"`cordis.yml`.
- Tests use local HTTP servers and recorded harness translator/serializer output. Real"},{"id":"p37s6","text":" OAuth and model availability remain vendor-controlled."}],"truncated":true}
